banner: The assistant is offline on this server, so tiers 1 and 2 are unavailable. Built-in analyses run as usual; answers are limited to the catalog.

tiers.title: Composed analyses
tiers.subtitle: The assistant combines the built-in steps into new pipelines.

items.title: Any spectral index
items.description: Band math for indices not in the catalog, from the bands the image has.
items.recipe: NDMI = (B5 − B6)/(B5 + B6) · NBR · SAVI · NDBI · custom
items.prompt: Map moisture change with NDMI between the two dates

items.title: Masked classification
items.description: Mask → classify → statistics, so classes are reported only where they matter.
items.prompt: Classify land cover on the flooded fields

items.title: Multi-date comparison
items.description: The same index on three or more dates, as a time series and a difference stack.

items.title: Parameter changes
items.description: Re-run a step with a different threshold, band set or cloud limit.
items.prompt: Redo the water map with a 0.1 threshold

tiers.title: Built-in analyses
tiers.subtitle: Run without the assistant — the catalog every installation has.

items.title: NDVI
items.description: Vegetation density and health.
items.prompt: Map vegetation health across the region

items.title: EVI
items.description: Vegetation in dense canopy where NDVI saturates.
items.prompt: Use EVI instead of NDVI for the forest

items.title: NDWI
items.description: Open water and surface moisture.
items.prompt: Where is open water on 9 June?

items.title: NDSI
items.description: Snow and ice; values above 0.42 usually mean snow.

items.title: Change detection
items.description: Difference of NDVI, NDWI or NDSI between two dates, with lost / gained / unchanged classes and areas.
items.prompt: Compare water before and after the dam breach

items.title: Land-cover classification
items.description: Six classes: water, snow/ice, bare soil, sparse vegetation, cropland/grassland, dense vegetation. Legend and per-class area.
items.prompt: Classify land cover on the flooded fields

items.title: Snow classifier
items.description: Multi-criteria: NDSI ≥ 0.4, NDVI below 0.1 and brightness above 0.3.

items.title: Raster statistics
items.description: Min, max, mean, standard deviation, percentiles and histogram per band.
items.prompt: Give me statistics for every band

items.title: Field boundaries
items.description: Agricultural parcels as polygons, with an area histogram.
items.prompt: Detect field boundaries east of the river

items.title: ConvLSTM NDVI forecast
items.description: ConvLSTM NDVI Forecasting Model - Predicts vegetation health in Ukrainian agricultural regions. Uses 6 weeks of input data to forecast 4 future weeks of NDVI values. Trained on Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, and Mykolaiv oblasts (2018-2021).

items.title: PINN-LINDA nowcasting
items.description: PINN-LINDA Weather Nowcasting - Physics-Informed Neural Network implementing LINDA (Lagrangian Integro-Difference equation with Nowcasting and Data Assimilation) for short-term precipitation forecasting. Compares traditional LINDA with PINN-enhanced approaches using radar precipitation sequences.

items.title: VI forecasting DTI
items.description: Vegetation Index Forecasting DTI - Time-series forecasting model for vegetation indices using Google Earth Engine integration.

items.title: Runoff ensemble
items.description: Ensemble runoff estimates from precipitation and land-cover inputs.
